description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter' that implements the 'SnapshotAdapter' interface. It provides methods for converting snapshot entities to and from MongoDB-compatible formats, specifically handling JSON serialization/deserialization of Jsonifiable objects, and integrates with Akka persistence snapshots. The class is designed to be extended for specific Jsonifiable types, allowing customization of snapshot conversion logic.

classes.name: AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class providing MongoDB-specific snapshot conversion logic for Jsonifiable objects, intended to be extended for specific entity types.

methods.name: toSnapshotStore
methods.description: Converts a Jsonifiable snapshot entity into a MongoDB-compatible object, by serializing it as JSON and then parsing it into a format suitable for storage.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore
methods.description: Reconstructs a Jsonifiable object from an Akka snapshot or selected snapshot, handling the deserialization process.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable entity into a JsonObject, considering schema version and field types.

methods.name: convertSnapshotToJsonifiable
methods.description: Attempts to create a Jsonifiable object from a raw snapshot entity, returning null if deserialization fails.

methods.name: convertSnapshotEntityToJson
methods.description: Converts a raw snapshot entity to a JsonObject, expecting it to be a BsonValue.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Converts a BsonValue into a JsonObject using DittoBsonJson.

methods.name: tryToCreateJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Tries to deserialize a JsonObject into a Jsonifiable object, catching exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to create a Jsonifiable object from a JsonObject.
